CommunityApplications.Profile:
Gantry is a single-container Docker and server monitor built for Unraid.
Install it, open the web UI, and set a username and password the first time to secure it -- then the dashboard is live, a realtime view of every container's CPU, memory, network, disk IO and per-container GPU usage, your array and pool disks with capacity and temperature, and cross-container insights that explain when one container is slowing another or the array.
Monitoring is read-only and never touches your array configuration. The only writes Gantry can make are the explicit cleanup you trigger yourself from the Maintenance view -- removing dangling images and stopped containers -- each behind a confirmation, never force-removing, never touching a running container or a volume. Set GANTRY_READ_ONLY=1 to disable even that. It never runs privileged.
**Support:** open an issue at https://github.com/smidley/gantry/issues
